content:
{'今日，Sonos 除咗推出兩款新產品之外，亦公布咗佢哋軟件平台嘅全新品牌「Sonos 27」，並詳細介紹咗即將喺今個秋季推出畀 Sonos 用戶嘅四項新功能。': 'Today, in addition to launching two new products, Sonos also announced the new brand for its software platform, "Sonos 27," and detailed four new features coming to Sonos users this fall.'}

{'以下係今個秋季推出嘅四項全新「Sonos 27」功能': 'Here are the four new "Sonos 27" features launching this fall'}

{'Sonos 今日除咗推出 Sonos Ace Ultra 頭戴式耳機之外，亦發表咗 Sonos Beam Ultra 喇叭。除咗硬件方面嘅新嘢之外，公司仲重新打造咗佢哋嘅軟件品牌形象。': 'Today, Sonos not only launched the Sonos Ace Ultra headphones but also unveiled the Sonos Beam Ultra speaker. Beyond the new hardware, the company has also revamped its software brand image.'}

{'「Sonos 27」係 Sonos 軟件平台嘅官方名稱，呢個平台其實早已存在，只係由今日開始先有正式嘅名字。Sonos 亦同時公布咗四項將於今個秋季推出嘅全新軟件功能：': '"Sonos 27" is the official name of Sonos\'s software platform. This platform has actually existed for some time, but it only received an official name starting today. Sonos also simultaneously announced four new software features set to launch this fall:'}

  • {'便攜式環繞聲效': 'Portable Surround Sound'}
  • {'個人聆聽體驗': 'Personal Listening Experience'}
  • {'Sonos 27voice 語音功能': 'Sonos 27voice Voice Feature'}
  • {'Sonos MCP': 'Sonos MCP'}

{'便攜式環繞聲效': 'Portable Surround Sound'}

{'個人聆聽體驗，無縫銜接': 'Personal Listening Experience, Seamless Continuity'}

{'全新 Sonos 語音體驗': 'Brand New Sonos Voice Experience'}

{'用你已經熟悉嘅 AI 操控 Sonos': "Control Sonos with AI you're already familiar with"}

{'想了解呢啲全新 Sonos 27 功能嘅更多詳情，包括實際推出日期同早期試用計劃，請到 Sonos 官網瀏覽。': 'For more details on these new Sonos 27 features, including actual launch dates and early access programs, please visit the Sonos official website.'}

{'你點睇 Sonos 嘅最新公布同 Sonos 27 軟件平台？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅意見。': "What do you think of Sonos's latest announcements and the Sonos 27 software platform? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section."}
